svg.text: Deck 200 × 140 × 4.4 mm, 2.4 mm floor, 3 mm lip to 4.4, R5 corners, 15 × 60 notch — all verified against the mesh.
Plan view, origin lower-left, mm. Only hole-matched boards stacked. MCP23017 removed.
LOWER 12V in, DROK feeds, F2-F5 taps
Ø3.6 M3 chassis mount ×4 — 94.0 × 124.0 pattern, keep-out Ø9
• LOWER — 12V in: fan-out to the four DROK inputs, F2–F5 branch taps
• UPPER — output side: 9V / 5V / 6V / 3.3V out to loads
• Fuse block 50×38 — 50 mm edge faces the notch
• Steering servos CH0–5 — V+ = 5V (R2), 1000µF on C2
• Arm servos — V+ = 6V (R3), 2200µF Rubycon on C2
• Pico 2 W — 6× quadrature encoders, VSYS from R5 3V3
• Pico 2 W — 3× HC-SR04 + BNO085 RST, VSYS from Pi 5V
• GODIYMODULES hub, 10 ports + 1 input — 8 drops, 2 spare
• A0 battery ÷, A1 FSR — nearest the signal board
holes: MEASURE — differs from Adafruit ref
Adafruit #1085 outline; your part may differ
• BNO085 9-DoF IMU — X/Y axes parallel to chassis
• I²C accelerator — no address; put it inline on the trunk
holes: MEASURE — DONGKER module, no published dims

ONE hub assumed — 10 ports + 1 input covers all 8 drops.
